verdict.rationale: Lambda documents workspace firewall rules that control incoming traffic to instances, globally or per instance, which covers managing which ports are reachable for serving apps. Node-to-node connectivity is documented only within 1-Click Clusters (GPUDirect RDMA interconnect), not as general private networking between standalone instances. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure/inbound-allow documentation, private networking or VPC between ODC instances, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: You can restrict incoming traffic to the instances in a workspace, including 1-Click Cluster management (head) nodes, by creating firewall rules on the Firewall page
You can create global rules that apply to all of the instances in the workspace, or rulesets scoped to individual instances and their regions.
enabling peer-to-peer GPUDirect RDMA at up to 3200 Gb/s
